title: PROFASR-BENCH: A PROFESSIONAL-TALK ASR DATASET FOR HIGH-STAKES APPLICATIONS EXPOSING THE CONTEXT-UTILIZATION GAP
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance and demographic fairness (specifically accent and gender bias) in professional domains such as medicine and law. It does not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
